07:30 — Breakfast with the crew. Kelly: “Shall we tackle module 3 after coffee?” Sustained exchange with Okafor (3 lines). Laughs at a joke by Okafor.
08:30 — Briefing with Earth (delayed message). Kelly does not speak.
10:00 — Air filtration system maintenance: abandoned midway, postponed to tomorrow. Kelly: “It's fine, I don't need help.”
12:40 — Eats alone in his cabin, ration half eaten.
14:00 — Exercise session: cut short at 25 of 60 min. Says he feels cold despite normal temperature.
16:00 — Biology experiment with Okafor. Kelly forgets a step; Okafor redoes it without comment.
17:30 — Delayed video call with his family (recorded messages). Short recorded message (2 min), neutral tone.
19:30 — Shared dinner. Kelly: “Movie tonight, I'm choosing.”
21:00 — Declines the movie night suggested by Ito: “Go ahead without me tonight.”
